01 01 — NewCode · Web Development

Websites that are fast, clear, and ready to sell.

One concept per website: read from your business, not from a marketplace template. The result is a page that stays light, reads well on a phone, and points visitors at one clear action.

What you can order

  • →Business profile websiteA serious presence for businesses, services, and small companies.
  • →Product / service landing pageOne focused page for one offer.
  • →Portfolio & online CVYour work and experience in a single link.
  • →Catalogue & simple storeA tidy product list with a direct order button.
  • →Interactive web toolsCalculators, quizzes, directories, and tools visitors can try right on the page.

What you receive

  • A finished website, live online — a link you can share with customers right away.
  • Looks right on phone & desktop, including light and dark mode following the visitor's device.
  • Light for low-end phones — no heavy effects; text fully readable and quick to load.
  • A short guide on how to use and update the basic content of your site.
Open its own page → The NewCode service is pre-selected in the order form.
02 02 — Forge · Game Development

Complete browser games, playable instantly.

Two ways to play: HTML5 games that run in phone and desktop browsers — no install, no download — and Android games as a ready-to-install APK file for your phone. Either way, built as complete games: a goal, challenge that rises step by step, and a scoring system.

What you can order

  • →Action & arena gamesEnemy waves, power-ups, bosses, and a scoring system.
  • →Light strategy gamesTower defence and resource management that run in the browser.
  • →Educational & quiz gamesLearning material packaged as a scored game.
  • →Brand / event promo gamesVisitors play; your brand is what they remember.
  • →Prototype → full gameStart from the core mechanic, then grow it step by step into a complete game.
  • →Android Game (APK)The complete game delivered as an APK file you install on an Android phone.

What you receive

  • A game link that plays instantly in the browser, plus the source files.
  • Full controls — touch & swipe on phones, keyboard on desktop.
  • A complete game system — challenge waves, varied enemies/opponents, power-ups, and rising difficulty.
  • A visual theme matched to your brand or event.
  • Ready-to-install Android APK file — your game as a file you install directly on an Android phone.
Open its own page → The Forge service is pre-selected in the order form.
03 03 — LWD Studio · Brand & Visual Design

A brand identity that stays consistent everywhere.

Logos, illustration, and visual assets in one recognisable style everywhere — from a store thumbnail to packaging. Colours and type are locked in from the start, so your brand never changes its face.

What you can order

  • →Logo & brand identityPrimary logo, variations, and a colour + type guide.
  • →Illustration & pixel artCustom illustration for products, content, and merchandise.
  • →Social media designTemplates and visual assets consistent with your brand.
  • →Digital assetsStickers, icons, patterns, and ready-to-use graphic packs.
  • →Packaging & label designA product look that convinces at first glance.

What you receive

  • Final files, ready to use in the formats you need (PNG/SVG/PDF, depending on the work).
  • A locked colour palette & type — your brand looks the same on web, packaging, and social media.
  • Variations for every size — from a favicon to a large banner.
  • A distinctive style, drawn for your brand, not marketplace stock.
Selected work — First client

MomiRel — Homemade Dessert · BSD, Tangerang Selatan

Hand-drawn logo and brand identity for a home-dessert brand, modelled on the owner and her daughter baking together. Delivered as a complete set: a print-ready version for spunbond bags, burgundy and maroon editions, a die-cut sticker, and a round stamp for packaging.

Open its own page → The LWD Studio service is pre-selected in the order form.
04 04 — Lead Engine · Leads & Ops

Leads come in messy, and leave ready to act on.

Lead Engine tidies scattered leads, scores them by priority, builds the pipeline, and prepares follow-up drafts — drafts only; messages are never sent automatically. You review them, and you press send.

What you can order

  • →Lead list clean-upData from chats, email, and forms merged into one clean list, no duplicates.
  • →Lead scoring & priorityEvery lead scored with the same rubric, so it is clear who to chase first.
  • →Sales pipelineClear stages from new lead to closing — who is waiting on what stays visible.
  • →Follow-up draftsFollow-up messages written for each priority lead. Drafts only — never sent automatically.
  • →Regular reportsA summary of leads in, moving, and stalled, in an easy-to-read format.

What you receive

  • One clean lead list — no duplicates, with clear source and status.
  • A score + reason for every lead, calculated from a written rubric you can inspect and re-weight.
  • A staged pipeline showing which leads are waiting on your action.
  • Follow-up drafts ready to review — you decide whether they get sent. No message ever runs on its own.
Open its own page → Open the Lead Engine workspace → The Lead Engine service is pre-selected in the order form.

        Frequently Asked
        
      Before you order.
      
        
      
          
      
            How much does it cost?
            
      It depends on scope — the deciding factors are listed openly in the How to Order section. You receive a written price breakdown before work begins, and that figure never changes mid-way without your approval.
      
          
      
          
      
            How long does it take?
            
      The exact schedule is written in the quote, matched to the queue and the level of difficulty. The studio's working capacity is up to 40 hours per week, and you hear from me at every stage — never silence followed by a sudden delivery.
      
          
      
          
      
            Can I request revisions?
            
      Yes. The number of revision rounds is agreed up front and written into the quote, so both sides are clear from day one.
      
          
      
          
      
            Does Lead Engine send follow-up messages to my leads automatically?
            
      Never. Lead Engine only prepares follow-up drafts. You review every message yourself, and you press send — no message ever goes out without your approval.
      
          
      
          
      
            Can I order more than one service at once?
            
      Yes — for example a website from NewCode with a logo from LWD Studio, a promo mini-game from Forge, and the leads tidied by Lead Engine. Just mention everything in one message; the details are combined into a single quote.
